    The best VPNs you can buy right now include NordVPN, Proton VPN, ExpressVPN, Surfshark, and Private Internet Access, with prices starting around $2–$4 per month depending on the plan.

    Recommended VPNs to Buy

    Based on current rankings and deals, these services offer the strongest mix of privacy, speed, and value:

    • NordVPN – Best overall; fast speeds, strong privacy audits, bundles with antivirus; deals from about $3.49–$3.99/mo on long-term plans. Gizmodo
    • Proton VPN – Best for privacy; Swiss-based, open-source apps; long‑term plans around $2.49/mo. Gizmodo+1
    • ExpressVPN – Easiest to use; excellent streaming performance; about $2.99/mo on multi‑year deals. Gizmodo
    • Surfshark – Best value; unlimited devices; around $2.49/mo. Gizmodo+1
    • Private Internet Access (PIA) – Best budget option; unlimited devices; about $2.19/mo. Gizmodo

    Where to Buy

    You can purchase VPN subscriptions directly from their official websites using card, PayPal, or crypto. NordVPN, for example, offers multiple tiers with 30‑day money‑back guarantees and secure payment options. NordVPN

    What to Consider Before Buying

    • Speed & performance: NordVPN and ExpressVPN show the lowest speed loss in tests. Gizmodo
    • Privacy: Proton VPN and NordVPN have strong no‑logs audits. Gizmodo
    • Streaming: ExpressVPN and NordVPN unblock the most streaming services. Gizmodo
    • Devices: Surfshark and PIA allow unlimited devices. Gizmodo
    • Refunds: Most top VPNs offer 30‑day money‑back guarantees.

    Summary

    Buying a VPN is straightforward: choose a provider based on privacy, speed, and price, then subscribe through its official site. NordVPN, Proton VPN, ExpressVPN, Surfshark, and PIA currently offer the strongest value according to independent testing and deal comparisons.
